body: Original reference implementation of "3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering"
plain_description: **Create detailed 3D scenes from photos or video and render new viewpoints in real time.** Train a scene model from COLMAP or synthetic NeRF data, then inspect it with interactive viewers.
technical_description: Official research implementation for 3D Gaussian Splatting. It trains a scene representation from COLMAP or synthetic NeRF datasets using a PyTorch optimizer and CUDA extensions, then renders novel views with an OpenGL viewer. Includes tools for dataset conversion, evaluation, and interactive inspection; training requires a CUDA-ready GPU.
title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
